description: Actions the engine may propose after an answer. Nothing is written to a system without a decision; high-impact actions need an approver of the action's role (see policies/human-check.md). Template words: {stores} {portfolio} {count} {exposed} {week} {launch} {next} {nextDate}.

signoff.description: Who signs off a change to a context file, by the team that owns the file (the file's owner field). The author of a change never signs it off.

drive-thru-diagnosis.title: Service breach review for {stores}
drive-thru-diagnosis.detail: Diagnosis attached: window time on exposed single-lane kitchens drives the rise since the {launch} launch. Confirm the cause on site within 24 hours.

recovery-plan.title: Pre-stage {launch} components at {stores} from tomorrow
recovery-plan.detail: Ops playbook step 1 in the 10am and 4pm pre-rush. Review window time after five trading days.

recovery-plan.title: Brief area coaches on the recovery plan for {portfolio}
recovery-plan.detail: Share the playbook steps, the review date and the escalation trigger (window time above 50 sec).

store-priorities.title: Store visit list for {portfolio}, {week}
store-priorities.detail: Visit the stores in the order given, highest revenue at risk first.

what-if-prestage.title: Trial pre-staging at {stores}
what-if-prestage.detail: Run the pre-staging trial the what-if sized, and compare window time after five trading days.

what-if-prep-station.title: Request PPS-2 retrofit kits for the exposed single-lane kitchens in {portfolio}
what-if-prep-station.detail: Kits for {exposed} exposed single-lane kitchens, allocated by revenue at risk per the kit decision record.

diego/double-stack-by-region.title: Flag the regions where single-lane stores are struggling with the {launch}
diego/double-stack-by-region.detail: Post the regional cut to #double-stack-promo so media plans follow kitchen capacity.

diego/rollout-back-on-track.title: {launch} rollout recovery plan for {stores}
diego/rollout-back-on-track.detail: Pre-staging everywhere first, then retrofits by revenue at risk, then media back on.

diego/adjust-the-promo.title: Shift {launch} promo spend toward dual-lane markets
diego/adjust-the-promo.detail: Hold paid media where exposed single-lane kitchens are over benchmark; keep it where kitchens cope.

diego/pause-double-stack.title: Decision request: pause the {launch} at single-lane stores
diego/pause-double-stack.detail: The what-if sized the revenue impact. A pause changes the menu at many stores and needs a sign-off.

diego/delay-next-lto.title: Decision request: move the {next} launch from {nextDate}
diego/delay-next-lto.detail: The what-if compared launching on {nextDate} with a two-week delay.

lena/southeast-sauce-short.title: Post the Stack Sauce shortfall cause to #ops-southeast
lena/southeast-sauce-short.detail: Allocation followed the launch plan mix; actual mix runs above it.

lena/fastest-retrofit.title: Ship PPS-2 kits and book install crews for {stores}
lena/fastest-retrofit.detail: Kits from the nearest distribution centre, installs ordered by revenue at risk, three crews at one install a night.

lena/rebalance-stock.title: Stock transfer between distribution centres, {week}
lena/rebalance-stock.detail: Move Stack Sauce cases from the donor centres to the short region; donors keep their minimum days of cover.

lena/retrofit-every-single-lane.title: Purchase request: PPS-2 kits for every exposed single-lane kitchen
lena/retrofit-every-single-lane.detail: The what-if sized the kits, cost and install time across {stores}.

lena/honey-heat-readiness.title: {next} readiness actions before {nextDate}
lena/honey-heat-readiness.detail: Kitchens that are not ready get pre-staging and a review before launch; sauce and stock cover confirmed by region.

maya/monday-digest-lead.title: Publish the Monday ops digest, {week}
maya/monday-digest-lead.detail: Lead with the findings in the order given.

maya/marcus-first-moves.title: First moves for {stores}
maya/marcus-first-moves.detail: Pre-staging tomorrow; retrofit request for the hardest-hit stores; review after five trading days.

maya/revenue-at-risk-4-weeks.title: Share the four-week revenue-at-risk projection for {portfolio}
maya/revenue-at-risk-4-weeks.detail: Low, central and high case, with the rule used.

maya/marcus-three-prep-stations.title: Request PPS-2 kits for the three hardest-hit stores in {portfolio}
maya/marcus-three-prep-stations.detail: As sized by the what-if; allocation follows the kit decision record.

priya/launch-or-staffing.title: Staffing review for operators whose fill rate slid before the launch
priya/launch-or-staffing.detail: Separate the staffing problem from the {launch} effect before choosing a fix.

priya/playbook-worst-stores.title: Roll out ops playbook step 1 at the worst single-lane stores
priya/playbook-worst-stores.detail: Pre-stage in the 10am and 4pm pre-rush from the next trading day; review after five trading days.

priya/operators-intervention.title: Corporate ops reviews for the operators that qualify this quarter
priya/operators-intervention.detail: One review per qualifying operator, owned by Franchise Relations with Store Ops.

priya/traffic-up-8-percent.title: Warn area coaches which segments break first if traffic rises
priya/traffic-up-8-percent.detail: Share the segments the what-if found closest to a service breach.

priya/prestage-everywhere.title: Pre-staging at every single-lane store from Monday
priya/prestage-everywhere.detail: Network-wide ops playbook step 1, with a review after five trading days.

sam/why-complaints-up.title: Tell the care desk why wait-time complaints are up
sam/why-complaints-up.detail: The cause is drive-thru wait at single-lane stores since the {launch} launch, not the burger itself.

sam/what-to-tell-customers.title: Publish the wait-time reply script to the care desk
sam/what-to-tell-customers.detail: Apologise, the store team is on it, $5 voucher; never promise a fix date.

sam/escalate-to-ops.title: Escalate the stores generating the most wait-time complaints, {week}
sam/escalate-to-ops.detail: One ticket per store over the escalation rule, ticket numbers attached, no customer details.

sam/staff-for-4-weeks.title: Care queue staffing plan for the next four weeks
sam/staff-for-4-weeks.detail: Agent hours sized from the forecast complaint volume and handling time.

sam/complaints-after-prestaging.title: Share the complaint outlook once single-lane stores pre-stage
sam/complaints-after-prestaging.detail: When complaints should come back down, so the care desk can plan.
